Charriere, Negociations dans le Levant IV (1860) prints 10 Lancosme letters in clear from 'Corr. de Turquie, Harlay' (Pera/Constantinople 16 Apr, 30 Apr, 14+28 May, 11+20 June, 25 July 1586; 20 Jan, 3 Feb, 19 Feb, 2 Mar, 20 Apr 1588) and no Lancosme letter of 1587; the decipherment leaf c295 (dated 20 juin 1586) matches his 'Pera, 11 et 20 juin 1586'
Tomokiyo henryiii.htm: 'He used the following cipher in letters of 1588 preserved in BnF fr.16144, ff.75-206 ... a symbol to double the preceding letter' (table as an image on his page, not on disk)
the open letter is a 'Duplicata': an original may exist elsewhere (another Harlay volume, the recipient's papers) -- not searched
